title: The Midnight Gallery
charge: That curator Noah Bell did steal the painting 'Winter Mirror' from the city gallery.
setting: Municipal Gallery, closing night of the Winter exhibit
case_summary: Winter Mirror vanished after closing. Noah Bell's office keycard opened the east wing. Prosecution says Noah staged a theft for insurance; defense says a guest list forger and a disabled camera prove an outside job.
solution: Noah stole Winter Mirror. He disabled camera 4, used his keycard, and sold a forged provenance trail. The 'guest forger' story was his cover.

prosecution.name: DA Priya Shah
prosecution.persona: Theatrical, frames narrative beats for the jury.
brief: Noah's keycard opened the east wing at 23:41.
Camera 4 was powered off from Noah's office terminal.
Noah recently inquired about high-value art insurance payouts.
Argue guilt; do not leak the word solution or secret briefs.

defense.name: Attorney Keiko Ito
brief: Guest badges were reprinted that afternoon with a known forger's watermark.
Camera 4 had prior intermittent outages logged by facilities.
Noah reported the missing painting himself within minutes.
Argue not guilty with doubt; never concede the theft.

evidence.text: Keycard logs show Noah's card opened the east wing at 23:41.
Camera 4 was powered off from a terminal in Noah's office.
Guest badges reprinted that day carry a known forger's watermark.
